summary: This video highlights the best starting strategies and rewards for new and returning players in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Creator Suzi Plays explains how to claim free legendary heroes like Auster via streamer links, Hochadir from initial progression, and Lossenia from day 2 login. She offers guidance on First Blush Wish Banner picks, paid starter pack choices, creator code redemption, and advises saving summons for the upcoming Anniversary event.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: Obtainable for free via streamer invitation link; excellent Frost DPS hero for pushing early content and Magic Chess.

heroes.name: Cervinia
heroes.note: Claimed along with Auster through the creator benefit link to aid early progression.

heroes.name: Hochadir
heroes.note: Provided for free in early gameplay to form a strong initial Frost core.

heroes.name: Lossenia
heroes.note: Claimable on Day 2 login, pairing with Auster and Hochadir to build a robust early Frost team.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Key unit for Dauntless teams, providing outstanding single-target DPS when fully upgraded.

heroes.name: Lelwanis
heroes.note: A strong option to select at the 300-summon milestone if building summoner team compositions.

heroes.name: Thelendor
heroes.note: Recommended hero choice on the wish banner for Rally team synergies.

heroes.name: Monelisse
heroes.note: Pairs exceptionally well alongside Thelendor in Rally team compositions.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Recommended Toxin DPS choice from the $4.99 Legendary Hero Option Chest to build toward a Serpentemis comp.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Solid Toxin choice from the paid hero chest to set up strong future Poison/Toxin teams.

meta_changes: New streamer benefit events grant Auster and Cervinia to new and returning accounts upon registration.
tips: Never pull on the standard Heliolite banner beyond the initial hidden 20-pull guarantee.
Target Nastjenka on the First Blush Wish Banner as she is a core single-target Dauntless DPS.
Save accumulated summons for the Anniversary events rather than rushing non-essential banners.
Enter creator code 'suziplays' in the Treasure Market under the Monthly tab to claim a free summon.
Save all War-marrow resources exclusively to convert into summons.
Consider purchasing the $4.99 Vow of Companionship pack to select top Toxin heroes like Twitch or Durango.
